title: Customer panel
nav.label: Panel menu
login.title: Open your bookings
login.description: Enter the phone number you booked with and we will send you a sign-in code.
login.footer: Codes go only to numbers a business has on record. You see the bookings of every business in one place.
login.code_description: If the number is on record, we sent a 6 digit code to {{phone}}.
login.invalid_code: The code is wrong or has expired. Ask for a new one.
reservations.title: My bookings
reservations.description: Every booking made with your phone number, whichever business it is with.
reservations.empty_upcoming_description: A new booking shows up here.
reservations.empty_past_description: Completed and cancelled bookings are listed here.
detail.title: Booking
detail.not_found: The booking was not found or is not yours.
detail.awaiting: Your request is waiting for the business to approve it.
detail.awaiting_until: Your request is waiting for the business to approve it. Without an answer by {{at}} it is cancelled on its own.
detail.reschedule_until: You can change the time until {{at}}.
policies.title: Business rules
cancel.title: Cancel the booking?
cancel.description: Your booking is cancelled and its time is freed for others. This cannot be undone.
reschedule.description: Pick a new free time for the same services. Your old time is let go only once the new one is taken.
reschedule.closed: The business is closed that day
reschedule.too_far: That day is not open for booking yet
reschedule.too_soon: It is too late for that day
reasons.status: The booking cannot be changed in its current state.
reasons.cutoff: The time the business allows has passed; call the business to change it.
reasons.business_unavailable: The business does not take online changes right now.
reasons.online_unavailable: The business does not take online bookings right now; call it to change the time.
reasons.services_changed: A service of this booking is no longer offered; call the business to change it.
errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.rate_limited: Too many attempts. Please wait a little.
errors.taken: The time you picked was just taken. Pick another time.
errors.stale: The booking changed while you were looking; the page was refreshed, try again.
errors.invalid_transition: This is not possible in the booking's current state.
payments.title: My payments
payments.description: What your bookings cost, what you paid and what you got back.
payments.note: Payments made at the business are recorded by the business; here you see each booking's payment status.
payments.empty_description: The amounts of your bookings are listed here.
profile.title: My profile
profile.description: Your verified number, the businesses that know you and your sessions.
profile.no_businesses_description: A business shows up here once you book with this number.
profile.logout_everywhere_description: Every open panel session of this number ends; each device needs a new code to sign in.
